name: 돌발성 탐지
description: Analyzes the burstiness patterns in text to distinguish AI-generated from human-written content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through analysis of sentence length and complexity variation
mechanism: Measures the variation (burstiness) in sentence structures, lengths, and complexity throughout a text. Human writing naturally varies between simple and complex sentences, short and long paragraphs. AI-generated text tends to maintain a more uniform level of complexity, resulting in lower burstiness scores.
source: Guo et al. (2023) - How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection, arXiv
algorithm: Sentence Length Variance + Structural Complexity Scoring + Moving Window Analysis
parameters: Window size: 5 sentences, Metrics: length variance, complexity index, transition entropy
strengths:
• Simple and interpretable metric
• Language-independent to some degree
• Works well combined with other text methods
• Fast computation on any text length
limitations:
• Lower accuracy as standalone detector
• Academic and technical writing naturally has low burstiness
• AI models are improving at mimicking human variability
• Very short texts are unreliable

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? arXiv.
